title: In Vitro Cleavage Assays using Purified Recombinant Drosophila Caspases for Substrate Screening
protocol: Clone the gene of interest into a bacterial expression vector with N- and/or C-terminal tag(s) using standard protocols.
Transform the vectors with the genes of interest into competent BL21 (DE3) pLysS E. coli cells using standard procedures.
Plate the transformation mixture on LB agar plates with kanamycin to select transformed bacteria.
Pick a colony from the plate and inoculate in 5 mL of LB medium containing kanamycin to grow overnight at 37 °C at 220 rpm on a shaking platform.
Prepare 30-50 mL (per sample) of LB medium with kanamycin and add 1 mL of the overnight grown culture.
Grow the culture at 37 °C at 220 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.6.
Add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.1-0.2 mM.
Grow cultures for 3 hours at 30 °C at 220 rpm.
Spin down the cultures in 50 mL centrifuge tubes for 20 minutes at 4 °C at 2,000 x g.
Discard the supernatant and proceed with the pellet.
Remove frozen tubes containing pelleted cultures from -80 °C storage and keep them on ice for 10 minutes to soften the pellet.

Add 0.6 mL of bacterial cell lysis buffer supplemented with freshly added protease inhibitors, 10 mg/mL lysozyme, and 50 U/mL benzonase into the pellet-containing tubes using a pipette controller with a 1 mL serological pipette.
Dissolve the pellet by pipetting up and down until a clear pale-yellow solution without any pellet particles is visible.
Incubate for 30 minutes on ice.
Transfer the lysate into appropriate centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the lysates at 17,000 x g for 40 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer supernatants into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Keep tubes on ice and proceed with Ni-NTA agarose purification.
Add 0.2 mL of the 50% slurry of Ni-NTA agarose to each tube of caspase extracts.
Rotate the tubes on an end-on-end rotator for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Place the extract with the Ni-NTA agarose into a 1 mL polypropylene column.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Remove the cap of the columns and let the supernatant flow out by gravity.
Carefully add 1 mL of wash buffer to the columns without disturbing the resin.
Perform washing step three times through gravity flow.
Place 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes under the collecting nozzle of the columns after draining.
Add 0.5 mL of elution buffer supplemented with 1x protease inhibitors to each column.
Collect the eluate in the 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Keep the eluates on ice and measure protein concentration by Bradford assay.
Confirm purity/homogeneity of purified caspases by SDS-PAGE followed by Coomassie Blue staining.
Add 25 µL of RRL to a 0.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 2 µL of reaction buffer to the tube.
Add 0.5 µL of Amino Acid Mixture -Minus Leucine (1 mM) to the tube.
Add 0.5 µL of Amino Acid Mixture-Minus Methionine (1 mM) to the tube.
Add 1 µL of Ribonuclease Inhibitor (40 U/µL) to the tube.
Add 2 µL of DNA Template (0.5 µg/µL) to the tube.
Add 1 µL of T7-RNA Polymerase to the tube.
Adjust the final volume of the reaction to 50 µL with nuclease-free water.
Gently mix the components by pipetting or stirring with a pipette tip.
Spin down the mixture briefly.

Mix 25 µL of RRL lysate, 2 µL of reaction buffer, 0.5 µL of Amino Acid Mixture-Minus Methionine (1 mM), 1 µL of Ribonuclease Inhibitor (40 U/µL), 2 µL of DNA Template (0.5 µg/µL), and 2 µL of S35-labeled Methionine in a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 µL of T7-RNA Polymerase to the mixture.
Adjust the final volume of the reaction to 50 µL with nuclease-free water.
Gently mix the components by pipetting or stirring with a pipette tip.
Spin down the mixture briefly.
Dispose of tips and tubes in a radioactive waste container.
Incubate the reaction at 30 °C for 90 min.
Briefly spin the tubes after incubation and place them on ice.
Check the expression level of the putative substrate in RRL by SDS-PAGE and immunoblotting/autoradiography.
Proceed to the in vitro cleavage assay or store the sample at -80 °C.
Take the putative substrate(s) generated, as described in section 4.
Use N-Myc-DriceC211A as model substrate.
Determine expression level of the putative substrate by immunoblot or autoradiography analysis.
Add 10 µg of purified caspase protein to the reaction mixture.
Bring total reaction volume to 50 µL with caspase assay buffer.
Incubate reactions in a water bath at 30 °C for 3 h.
Include catalytic mutant DroncC318A as control.
Stop reactions by transferring tubes on ice after 3 h.
Add one volume of LDS sample buffer containing 50 mM DTT to stop the reaction completely.
Incubate samples at 75 °C in a heat block for 10 min.
Quickly spin and mix by flicking samples.
Load 24 µL per sample and run SDS-PAGE or store samples at -20 °C.
Add 10 µg of purified candidate substrate to a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 µg of the purified caspase proteins to the mixture.
Bring total volume to 50 µL with caspase assay buffer for in vitro cleavage assay.
Follow steps 5.5 to 5.9 for subsequent processing.
Load 24 µL of cleavage reactions onto 4%-12% Tris-Glycine or Bis-Tris gradient gels.
Perform protein electrophoresis using standard procedures.
Conduct immunoblotting to visualize results using standard procedures.
Perform autoradiography if the substrates are S35-labeled.
